# Ringolo

> Ringolo (formerly Calorify) is an AI calorie counter and macro tracker for iPhone and iPad. Snap a meal and Ringolo estimates calories, protein, carbs and fat for every item; each meal fills a daily ring that shows what's left. Ringolo was called Calorify until December 2026.

- Logging: photo scan, voice, food search (everyday foods and local dishes, 15 languages), manual entry, favorites and recent foods. Every AI estimate can be checked and edited before it's saved.
- Tracking: a daily calorie ring with protein, carbs and fat targets, water, weight with a goal line and Apple Health sync, streaks, reports for a week, month, 3 months or a year, and Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.
- Reminders: meal reminders, a one-time reminder for your next meal, water reminders and a weekly weigh-in reminder.
- Premium: AI photo scans, voice logging and AI insights are part of Ringolo Premium, an auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription. Eligible Apple IDs may get an introductory trial; the terms are shown before you subscribe. New accounts can try AI photo scans in their first days.
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad with iOS or iPadOS 17.6 or later; 15 languages.
- Not a medical device. Nutrition values are estimates for general information.
